label: WHO sixth-edition semen examination and processing procedures
summary: The WHO sixth-edition semen manual describes procedures and methods for laboratory examination and processing of human semen.

sources.title: WHO laboratory manual for the examination and processing of human semen, 6th ed

label: WHO-described clinical and research uses of semen analysis
summary: The WHO semen manual states that semen analysis may be useful for investigating male fertility status and monitoring spermatogenesis during and following male fertility regulation and other interventions, in clinical and research settings.

sources.title: WHO laboratory manual for the examination and processing of human semen, 6th ed

label: AUA/ASRM varicocelectomy recommendation for selected infertile men
summary: The AUA/ASRM guideline recommends considering surgical varicocelectomy for men attempting conception who have palpable varicoceles, infertility and abnormal semen parameters, except azoospermic men; it labels this a moderate recommendation supported by Grade B evidence.

sources.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Infertility in Men: AUA/ASRM Guideline Part II

label: AUA/ASRM microdissection sperm retrieval recommendation in NOA
summary: The AUA/ASRM guideline recommends microdissection testicular sperm extraction for men with non-obstructive azoospermia undergoing sperm retrieval, assigning a moderate recommendation with Grade C evidence.

sources.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Infertility in Men: AUA/ASRM Guideline Part II

label: AUA/ASRM recommendation against testosterone monotherapy when fertility is desired
summary: The AUA/ASRM guideline states that testosterone monotherapy should not be prescribed to a male interested in current or future fertility, identifying this recommendation as a clinical principle.

sources.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Infertility in Men: AUA/ASRM Guideline Part II

label: AUA/ASRM uncertainty regarding fertility supplements
summary: The AUA/ASRM guideline reports that clear, reliable evidence is lacking for supplements offered to men attempting conception and describes their value for improving fertility outcomes as questionable.

sources.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Infertility in Men: AUA/ASRM Guideline Part II

label: AUA/ASRM sperm banking recommendation before gonadotoxic therapy
summary: The AUA/ASRM guideline advises clinicians to encourage sperm banking, preferably multiple specimens when possible, before gonadotoxic therapy or other cancer treatment that may affect male fertility; it classifies this as expert opinion.

sources.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Infertility in Men: AUA/ASRM Guideline Part II

label: AUA/ASRM-reported gaps in understanding male infertility causes
summary: In its future-directions discussion, the AUA/ASRM guideline states that the causes of male infertility, including their genetic basis, had been only superficially explained at the time of the guideline.

sources.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Infertility in Men: AUA/ASRM Guideline Part II

label: Endocrine Society hypogonadism diagnostic criteria
summary: The Endocrine Society guideline recommends diagnosing hypogonadism only in men with compatible symptoms and signs and unequivocally and consistently low serum testosterone concentrations.

sources.title: Testosterone Therapy for Hypogonadism Guideline Resources

label: Endocrine Society recommendation for repeat morning testosterone measurement
summary: The Endocrine Society guideline recommends confirming hypogonadism by repeating measurement of morning fasting total testosterone concentrations.

sources.title: Testosterone Therapy for Hypogonadism Guideline Resources

label: Endocrine Society hormonal evaluation of primary versus secondary hypogonadism
summary: For men with hypogonadism, the Endocrine Society guideline recommends measuring serum luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone concentrations to distinguish primary testicular from secondary pituitary-hypothalamic hypogonadism.

sources.title: Testosterone Therapy for Hypogonadism Guideline Resources

label: Endocrine Society recommendation against routine population screening for hypogonadism
summary: The Endocrine Society guideline recommends against routine screening of men in the general population for hypogonadism.

sources.title: Testosterone Therapy for Hypogonadism Guideline Resources
